_readme: Rotation corrections for /Photos, applied by scripts/optimize-photos.mjs.
These originals were shot vertically but written to disk as landscape files
with no EXIF orientation flag, so they need a manual quarter-turn.
Value = degrees to rotate, counter-clockwise negative: -90, 90 or 180.
Replacing a photograph? If it appears sideways on the site, add it here and
re-run `npm run photos:force`. If it looks right, leave it out.
